name: Tachibana Asane
source: The [url=/c71526]protagonist's[/url] sister who understands him the most. She dislikes normal men but loves her older brother and women, especially older and perverted women. Most of the time Asane is relaxed but as soon as she sees her favorite kind of women she loses control of herself completely. Her dream is to have a threesome with her brother and his girlfriend.
